redeemDoesNotDependOnDrip.detail: With every live-system precondition except dsr >= RAY, an owner's redeem of their full balance reverts: when block.timestamp > Pot.rho, SavingsDai.redeem calls Pot.drip, which computes chi' = rmul(rpow(dsr, now - rho), chi) < chi for dsr < RAY and reverts on the checked `tmp - chi` underflow. CEX (run d239cba6/5aacf739): dsr = 0.5 RAY, rho = 4, now = 7, rpow(dsr,1) < RAY, owner holds 1 share; Pot.drip reverts, so redeem reverts. Impact: if governance ever files dsr < RAY (Pot.file has no lower bound), every sDAI deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem reverts from the next block on, and since Pot.file itself requires rho == now (which needs a successful drip) the rate cannot be corrected except by Pot.cage (which resets dsr = RAY). Direct Pot depositors are not affected: Pot.exit has no rho == now requirement and lets them leave at the last stored chi. sDAI holders' DAI is frozen until cage.
redeemDoesNotDependOnDrip.cex_note: Trace values (run d239cba6): dsr=0.5 RAY, rho=4, now=7, rpowG(0.5 RAY,3,RAY)=1 (uninterpreted; real _rpow gives 0.125 RAY), chi~2.4e55. Holds for the real _rpow for every dsr < RAY.
